sonnet.problem: Verse 2 has two parallel lines, 'Your ways may be known on earth' and 'Your salvation among all nations.' Card 3 already asks the first. Card 4 asks the second, which is the same point, that the blessing is meant to reach beyond 'us.' This is a re-ask of the same fact.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question.

sonnet.problem: The card says the chorus 'comes right back word for word.' No earlier card showed the words of verse 3. Cards 5 and 6 only said the song calls someone to praise God. The baker has never seen the wording, so there is nothing to compare against.
sonnet.rule: He only points back to words a card has shown.
